Title: @better-auth/scim: Account/provider takeover via missing owner binding on non-org SCIM providers
Description: `@better-auth/scim` does not bind non-organization SCIM providers to their creator in the default configuration. Any authenticated user can manage another user's non-org provider, including reading its metadata, listing connections, regenerating its SCIM bearer token, and deleting the connection. Regenerating the token rotates it: the legitimate token stops working and the attacker holds a valid one.
NotImpacted: All versions before 1.5.0, all versions starting from 1.7.0-beta.4
